what: the contour the openshell bar buttons carried at this build, before the clip padding and interaction work

rendered.ink: two crowns plus a 1px side rail each side (outline, never a slab)
rendered.fill: one surface, inset 1px, #1b1a16 under the bar's paper
rendered.bar_metrics: bar=1920x48 start=93 tab0=85 gap=5.6 windows=90 clock=109 tabs=3 startx=18 tab0x=117 gapExact=5.6

states.idle: each cell is the profile with a 1px brass ink and an ink fill; labels read paper on ink
states.hover: the hovered cell fills brass over the crown; the outline is still there, the fill is not yet the reference's 6 per cent paper
states.activated: the active cell fills brass as well; this is the interaction look the next step replaces
states.resized: the window keeps its body and rows; its crown is not repainted after the drag

next: clip padding (0.5 outside, 1.5 inside), the hover/active fill from bar.css, and the application/taskbar look
